title: LG ThinQ Dryer Cycle Energy Use Leaderboard
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:dryer energy_kwh=*
| stats sum(energy_kwh) as total_value, avg(energy_kwh) as avg_value by program_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks program name values by total and average energy use across LG ThinQ dryer cycle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `energy_kwh` values for each LG ThinQ dryer cycle event and review total and average energy use by program name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total energy use.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which program name shows the biggest energy use numbers in your LG ThinQ dryer cycle data.
